title: Mark Ingram Atelier and Vera Wang Haute Team on Exclusive Bridal Experience
text:
Vera Wang Haute archival pieces and a shoppable collection of gowns is available by private appointment through July 25 at Mark Ingram Atelier.
Guests will be invited to walk through the atelier surrounded by select archival pieces that trace the arc of Wang’s influence onIn addition to the expansive display, over 25 Vera Wang Haute gowns will be available to shop through the duration of the event, available only in-store.
The dresses available for purchase are an assortment from past key and 2026 collections, ranging from $6,000 to $28,000.
“This collaboration is something we have dreamed of bringing to our brides for years. To host Vera’s archive alongside a shoppable collection of her most iconic work is an extraordinary privilege — and a moment we believe no bride in New York will want to miss,” saidThe Vera Wang Haute x Mark Ingram Atelier experience will be open by private appointment only. Appointments can be booked through the atelier’s website or contacting the salon directly. Space is limited.
The Mark Ingram Atelier is located a 515 Madison Avenue , second floor. WWD and Women's Wear Daily are part of Penske Media Corporation. © 2026 Fairchild Publishing, LLC. All Rights Reserved.
